home.title: Learn any language,
home.subtitle: Start from the basics — character charts with sound and short drills you can run today. Then learn with the community, because learning together is the best way to learn.

languages.title: Every language, from the basics up
languages.hint: Start with a language that's ready today — the rest are on the way.

library.title: A shelf of decks, soon filled by learners.
library.hint: Study sets in ChocoMemo are decks: themed collections of words, passages and quizzes. Learners will be able to publish their own decks and share them with the community — teaching each other is the best way to learn.

decks.title: Vocabulary decks
decks.hint: Themed decks of words — nature, animals, everyday things — to study in one place.

exam.title: Quiz sets
exam.hint: Any deck will turn into a multiple-choice quiz that shows which words still need work.

kana.title: Kana drills
kana.hint: Fast rounds through both syllabaries until the shapes come without thinking.

review.title: Spaced review
review.hint: Words you have studied will come back on a schedule, so nothing is forgotten.

space.hint: Each account will have a storage allowance for the decks you create and upload.

included.title: Included
included.hint: The allowance will come with every account and be shared by your decks and what you upload to them.

rent.title: Rent more
rent.hint: When a collection outgrows it, you'll be able to rent extra space in the shop.

how.title: A habit that sticks
how.hint: Four small steps, repeated every day — that's all it takes.

step1.title: Pick your language
step1.hint: Choose the language you're studying today.

step2.title: Pick a deck
step2.hint: Start with a built-in deck. Decks from other learners will follow.

step3.title: Drill and quiz
step3.hint: Short drills, five minutes at a time. Review and quizzes are rolling out.

step4.title: Create your own
step4.hint: Soon you'll add the words you keep forgetting and share them with other learners.

cta.title: Start from the first character.
cta.hint: No sign-up wall between you and the first drill. Account features, like syncing your decks, are on the way.

guide.title: How to use ChocoMemo
guide.subtitle: A short tour of the app: what every area does, and the order that makes a first session work.

quickStart.title: Four moves, one sitting
quickStart.hint: Read a chart, drill it, then review what you learned. Everything else in ChocoMemo is a variation on these three steps.

step1.title: Pick a language
step1.hint: The landing page lists every target. Picking one opens its vocabulary decks, and the choice is remembered on this device.

step2.title: Read the chart
step2.hint: Browse the character chart for the script you are learning and tap any glyph to hear it spoken aloud.

step3.title: Drill it
step3.hint: A timed multiple-choice round over the characters you picked. Set the timer, the question count and the groups to match your level.

step4.title: Review the words
step4.hint: Flashcards bring back the vocabulary you have studied, on a schedule, so nothing slips away.

sections.title: What each part does
sections.hint: One card per area of the app. Each card links straight to the page it describes.

landing.title: Landing page
landing.hint: The front door: what the app is, and the languages it teaches.
landing.point1: Every target language is listed as a full-width row — pick one to start.
landing.point2: The language you pick is remembered on the device and becomes the active target.
landing.point3: No sign-up wall: charts and decks are open before you create an account.

hub.title: Study hub
hub.hint: The overview you land on after choosing a language.
hub.point1: Characters — one tile per script, dominated by the glyph itself.
hub.point2: Drill — a list of character drills, one row each.
hub.point3: Decks — Learn (vocabulary, render), Practice (review, exam) and a Manage row for editing.

charts.title: Character charts
charts.hint: The reference view of a script, with sound on every character.
charts.point1: Kana (Japanese), the Latin alphabet (English) and Thai are implemented today.
charts.point2: Each chart is grouped — voiceless, voiced and contracted for kana; vowels and consonants for the alphabet.
charts.point3: Tap a character to hear it spoken. The voice follows the target language, not the interface language.
charts.point4: A reading order walks the chart for you and remembers how far you got.

drill.title: Character drill
drill.hint: The fast, multiple-choice round that turns recognition into recall.
drill.point1: Toggle the character groups and the question count, from all of them down to a handful.
drill.point2: A per-question timer with a countdown bar, and optional auto-advance.
drill.point3: Live Correct / Wrong / Timeout counters while you play.
drill.point4: At the end: a score rank, a breakdown of every answer, and a replay button.

decks.title: Vocabulary, render, review and exam
decks.hint: Four features over one shared deck list — they differ only in what happens when a deck opens.
decks.point1: Vocabulary decks hold the words; Render decks hold the reading material.
decks.point2: Review turns a deck into flashcards on a spaced schedule.
decks.point3: Exam turns a deck into a multiple-choice test.
decks.point4: The toolbar filters by target language, and sort, density and source are remembered on the device.

edit.title: Edit decks
edit.hint: One editor for every deck type, in a full-screen workspace of dockable panels.
edit.point1: Panels for the deck list, the editor, the preview, the inspector and the settings.
edit.point2: Arrange them yourself: drag, resize, pin a tab, or reset the layout.
edit.point3: On a phone the same panels become a tab strip with a slide-out menu.

voice.title: Voice and appearance
voice.hint: The settings that decide how the app sounds and looks.
voice.point1: Themes: pick one of the light and dark palettes, and the app follows.
voice.point2: Voice: choose which installed voice speaks the characters, with a preview button.
voice.point3: Interface: switch the interface language and hide the navbar for a distraction-free view.

account.title: Account and community
account.point1: Sign in or create an account to reach your profile and settings.
account.point2: Your public profile is addressable by name tag, so it can be shared.
account.point3: Cloud sync and community decks are on the way.
